subject: Greenhaven payments onboarding — bank info & PO routing
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenhavenfoods.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@greenhavenfoods.com, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payments onboarding — bank details + PO routing (Greenhaven)

Hi Marta,

Thanks for taking the onboarding with us — excited to get Greenhaven set up for supplier payments. To finish the vendor activation in our system, could you please confirm the following and return the completed onboarding form (attached):

- Wire/ACH instructions (bank name, account name, account number, routing/IBAN/SWIFT as applicable).
- Preferred remittance reference format (example: "PO-12345" or "GN-INV-2028-01").
- Do you require a Purchase Order number on invoices for payment to process? If so, is it mandatory or best-effort?
- Tax form (W-9) or equivalent — we need placement in your vendor profile.

I attached our payments-onboarding form and a sample invoice header to make PO mapping straightforward. If you prefer, you can also upload the bank file to the secure link below or sign the embedded DocuSign.

Attachments: redwood_payments_onboarding_form.xlsx (fillable), sample_invoice_header.csv
Secure upload / DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123

Goal: complete activation and run a single test wire (or micro-deposit) the week of Aug 1 so invoices due in mid-August can be paid on time.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Jonas and Marissa for PO mapping follow-up.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Finance Partner, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenhavenfoods.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenhaven Finance <accounts-payable@greenhavenfoods.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Payments onboarding — bank details + PO routing (Greenhaven)

Hi Lauren,

Appreciate the checklist — attaching our files. See answers below and let me know if you need anything else.

Bank instructions (attached as Greenhaven_Wire_Instructions.pdf):
- Bank: Harborbound Bank
- Account name: Greenhaven Foods Inc.
- Account number: 987654321
- Routing (ACH): 021000021
- SWIFT: HARBUS33

Remittance guidance:
- Please include the PO number in the invoice "Remittance Reference" field when sending payment. Format we prefer: PO# (e.g. PO123456) then a short invoice label.
- If a PO is not present, please include the invoice number and "AP-CONTACT: Marta Ruiz" in the remittance note.

PO policy:
- PO required for standard product orders > $2,500. For smaller ad-hoc charges (vendor services), PO is best-effort but payments team accepts invoices with a clear approver.

Tax form: Attached Greenhaven_W9.pdf.

We can accept either a micro-deposit ($0.10) verification or a $1.00 test wire — we prefer the test wire to validate SWIFT fields for cross-border flows. Please confirm which you plan to run.

Thanks — I copied our AP mailbox for record.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Finance Manager, Greenhaven Foods
marta.ruiz@greenhavenfoods.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Jul 2028 20:20:00 +0200
Subject: RE: Payments onboarding — bank details + PO routing (Greenhaven)

Lauren / Marissa — quick internal note after reviewing Marta's attachments:

- Wire details look complete; SWIFT present for cross-border.
- We should set PO mapping rule: when invoices include a PO# prefix "PO" or numeric string, map to invoice.header.po_number; otherwise fall back to invoice.header.invoice_number. Marissa, can you add this as a PO mapping rule in the vendor profile?
- For testing, I recommend a test wire for $1.00 (since Marta prefers test wire) to confirm SWIFT and remitter name. If network blocks wire, fall back to micro-deposit.
- Record in HubSpot: HS-85021 (I'll update deal notes).

Marissa — can you also confirm whether we need to create an alternate remittance email mapping (Greenhaven has centralized AP); we should surface AP email on the vendor record so our AR system sends remittance confirmation to accounts-payable@greenhavenfoods.com.

If no objections, Lauren — go ahead and schedule the test wire the week of Aug 2 and reply to Marta with the expected test amount and trace info.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior PayOps Engineer

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenhavenfoods.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@greenhavenfoods.com, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Jul 2028 22:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payments onboarding — bank details + PO routing (Greenhaven)

Hi Marta — got everything, thanks. Quick confirmation and next steps: 

1) We received Greenhaven_Wire_Instructions.pdf and Greenhaven_W9.pdf and the completed onboarding form. I uploaded the docs to the secure vendor profile and added a note to HubSpot (HS-85021).

2) Test wire: we will attempt a $1.00 test wire from Redwood (domestic routing to Harborbound Bank) on Tue Aug 2 at ~13:00 PDT.
   - If successful, we will mark the bank verified and proceed to activate automated payments for invoices once PO mapping is confirmed.
   - If the wire fails or is blocked, we will revert to a $0.10 micro-deposit and let you know.

3) PO mapping: Jonas proposed rule to map PO# -> invoice.header.po_number and fallback to invoice number. Marissa will add mapping and confirm by Mon Aug 1.

4) Remittance confirmation: We will email remittance confirmation and a payment stub to accounts-payable@greenhavenfoods.com after each payment. Please confirm if CC to any additional internal mailbox is required.

5) Next invoice cutoff: if all good, first cleared payment would be for invoices submitted by Aug 10 (pay cycle Aug 15).

Attachments: schedule_test_wire_instructions.txt (internal), vendor_activation_note.md (internal).

Would you like us to include a short vendor-facing onboarding note for your records? I can send a one-page PDF summarizing bank verification steps and PO expectations.

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Finance Partner, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

Onward: will update once test wire initiates and post trace/reference.
